about: Scenes for the animated video of Beyond Automation: Win Customers for Life. Each scene starts at a phrase in the narration ("at"); keys ending in At name phrases that trigger a move inside the scene. Chapter cards are added by render.mjs.

scenes.at: many companies are missing the point
scenes.label: The promise of AI
scenes.text: Efficiency, personalization and growth are real. But that's not the whole story.

scenes.label: AI before and after
scenes.note: The real magic happens in the second.

scenes.label: What AI does exceptionally well
cards: Common questions answered instantly, any time of day.
Tailored recommendations from a customer's history.
Routing, workflows, and summaries that get agents up to speed in seconds.

scenes.label: The irreplaceable human factor
cards: Reading between the lines, and responding with genuine care.
When it's off-script: creative thinking, and bending the rules when needed.
The trust that turns a satisfied customer into a loyal one.

scenes.label: Not AI or people
scenes.text: AI as a co-pilot for your customer service team.

scenes.at: The AI does the legwork by flagging an account
scenes.label: Example 1: proactive, personal outreach
items: an account repeatedly misusing a new feature
instead of a generic help article

scenes.label: Example 2: empathetic escalation
items: a frustrated tone in a chat
to a senior agent: “High frustration detected”

scenes.at: this collaborative model frees up your team
scenes.label: Going the extra mile
scenes.text: When AI handles high-volume, low-complexity work, people can do deep, proactive research.

scenes.at: Imagine a customer in a specialized field
scenes.label: Renewable energy logistics: a support ticket
items: compliance, supply chains for turbine parts

scenes.at: The customer is not just satisfied
scenes.label: The impact
scenes.text: A partner who invested in understanding their world.

scenes.at: Ultimately, AI is a powerful force
scenes.text: AI is a powerful force, but its direction is guided by your strategy.
